data.name: Joshua
data.gender_notes: Joshua is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Joshua is recorded in name-lists as “Yahweh is salvation”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Joshua expresses “Yahweh is salvation”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joshua total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
data.cultural_impact: Joshua is used in Hebrew naming tradition with the meaning “Yahweh is salvation”.
data.spiritual_significance: Any spiritual significance attached to Joshua is interpretive and is labelled as such.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning “Yahweh is salvation” is the basis of any symbolism attached to Joshua; such symbolism is interpretive.

tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yehoshua, 'Yahweh is salvation' — the same name as Jesus. Its root is Hebrew y-h-w-sh-ʿ. Joshua, successor of Moses; the Book of Joshua. Joshua is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh is salvation”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
